title: The Living creature in the pool
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：living　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 living 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the foreman wrote of ① a living creature in the pool in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so living that nobody in the site would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the living ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the living creature in the pool that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1987 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too living to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the living ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a living witness of the accident, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as living as the witness of the accident they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was living or not, and he said so.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something living, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite living; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the living ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003, with great care, she wrote of another living creature in the pool in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less living than anybody had expected. ⑩ The living witness of the accident that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2005, was the one she could never quite name; the living ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 活着（前置定语 a living creature in the pool：1993 年工头在施工单里记下的那件活着的活物）
B. adj. 活着／健在（两处加强说法：so living that … 与 no less living than …）
C. adj. 活着／健在（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 活着（表语 too living to do：母亲觉得它太活着，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 健在（前置定语 a living witness of the accident：叔叔把整件事称作一桩健在的证人）
F. adj. 健在（同级比较 as living as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那场事故的健在证人相比）
G. adj. 健在（后置定语 something living：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 健在（受程度副词修饰 quite living：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a living creature in the pool
the living creature in the pool that
a living witness of the accident
The living witness of the accident that

answers.why: living 意为“活着”，1993 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件活着的活物”，此处作前置定语 a living creature in the pool。
living 意为“活着”，此处用 so living that 结构，说它活着到工地里没人敢靠近。
living 意为“活着”，施工单上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的活着池子里的活物，等于最高级的说法。
living 意为“活着”，母亲认为这件东西“太活着了，谁也用不上”，too living to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
living 意为“健在”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩健在的证人”，此处作前置定语 a living witness of the accident。
living 意为“健在”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那场事故的健在证人一样健在”，同级比较用 as living as。
living 意为“健在”，施工单上那半行字要的是“健在的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something living。
living 意为“健在”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当健在”，quite 修饰原级 living。
living 意为“健在”，no less living than 表示“其健在不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之健在不亚于任何人的预料。
living 意为“健在”，母亲 2005 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的健在证人”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件活着的活物。（a living creature in the pool）
它活着到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so living that …）
母亲觉得它太活着，谁也用不上。（too living to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩健在的证人。（a living witness of the accident）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那场事故的健在证人一样健在。（as living as …）
到了 2000 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件健在的东西。（something living）
answers: In 1993 the foreman wrote of a living creature in the pool in the sheet.
It was so living that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too living to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a living witness of the accident.
He said nobody would call it as living as the witness of the accident they had once had.
By 2000 the sheet asked for nothing but something living.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 living 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the foreman wrote of a living creature in the pool in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the living creature in the pool that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too living to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a living witness of the accident, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite living, and everybody laughed.
The living ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
